items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 9:00 a.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman provided the land acknowledgment.  She recognized that March 15th is the International Day to Combat Islamophobia and encouraged everyone to take an opportunity to reflect on the importance of inclusion, understanding, and standing against discrimination in all its forms.

items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Motion to go into Closed Session
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman noted that there was a need to add two items to the closed session but because this is a Special Council meeting a motion to waive the procedural rules was needed to add the items.

items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
notes: William Short, Regional Clerk, informed Council that staff have begun onboarding incoming Councillor Matt Rodrigues. W. Short explained that M. Rodrigues' leave of absence with the City of Kitchener will begin on March 20, 2025 and his appointment to Regional Council will be effective March 21, 2025.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo suspend the rules of the Procedural By-law 22-051, as per sections 2.3 and 8.6, in order to suspend section 8.4. And that the suspension of the rules would allow Council to consider the two additional purposes to go into closed session which are the following: 1. Receiving information relating to a labour relations matter; and 2. Receiving information relating to an identifiable individual.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo suspend the rules of the Procedural By-law 22-051, as per sections 2.3 and 8.6, in order to suspend section 8.4.

And that the suspension of the rules would allow Council to consider the two additional purposes to go into closed session which are the following:
1.    Receiving information relating to a labour relations matter; and
2.    Receiving information relating to an identifiable individual.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of the Council be held on March 13, 2025 at 9:05 a.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to an ongoing legal matter. Receiving information relating to a labour relations matter; and Receiving information relating to an identifiable individual.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of the Council be held on March 13, 2025 at 9:05 a.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to an ongoing legal matter.
  2. Receiving information relating to a labour relations matter; and
  3. Receiving information relating to an identifiable individual.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to Fill the Vacancy of Regional Councillor – Kitchener through Appointment, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-008, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to Fill the Vacancy of Regional Councillor – Kitchener through Appointment, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-008, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 9:05 a.m.
